description: Server-to-server event requests to s2s.adjust.com/event, as query or form parameters.

params.name: app_token
params.description: It is the Adjust app token from the dashboard, and the endpoint requires it on every request.
params.fix_hint: Send the app token from the Adjust dashboard as `app_token`.

params.name: event_token
params.description: It is the Adjust event token from the dashboard, and the endpoint requires it on every request.
params.fix_hint: Send the event token from the Adjust dashboard as `event_token`.

params.name: s2s
params.description: Adjust documents a hardcoded `s2s=1` so the endpoint treats the request as server-to-server.
params.fix_hint: Add `s2s=1`.

params.name: created_at
params.description: Adjust documents `created_at` as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `created_at_unix` is the Unix-seconds alternative.
params.fix_hint: Send ISO 8601, such as `2017-01-02T15:04:05.000+0000`, or send `created_at_unix` instead.

params.name: created_at_unix
params.description: Adjust documents it as a Unix timestamp in seconds.
params.fix_hint: Send seconds, not milliseconds.

params.name: revenue
params.description: It is the revenue in full currency units, such as `149.99` for $149.99. Adjust documents a minimum of 0.001 and requires `currency` with it.
params.fix_hint: Send `revenue` as a number with no currency symbol, together with `currency`.

params.name: currency
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency code for a revenue event. Adjust documents it together with `revenue`.
params.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `EUR`, together with `revenue`.

params.name: environment
params.description: Adjust documents `sandbox` or `production`, and defaults to production when it is omitted.
params.fix_hint: Send `environment=sandbox` for testing, or `environment=production` for live traffic.

params.name: ip_address
params.description: It is the device IP address, sent unhashed. Adjust documents IPv4 only; IPv6 is not supported.
params.fix_hint: Send the device IPv4 address, not a digest and not an IPv6 address.

params.name: user_agent
params.description: It is the device user agent, URL-encoded, sent unhashed.
params.fix_hint: Send the raw user agent string, URL-encoded.

params.name: idfa
params.description: iOS Identifier for Advertisers. Adjust requires a device ID such as `idfa` or `gps_adid`.

params.name: gps_adid
params.description: Android advertising ID. Adjust requires a device ID such as `idfa` or `gps_adid`.

params.name: idfv
params.description: iOS Identifier for Vendor. Adjust documents uppercase with hyphens.
params.fix_hint: Send the IDFV in uppercase with hyphens, such as `D2CADB5F-410F-4963-AC0C-2A78534BDF1E`.

params.name: android_id
params.description: Raw Android ID. Adjust documents lowercase, without hyphens.
params.fix_hint: Send the Android ID in lowercase with no hyphens.

params.name: android_id_lower_md5
params.description: Hashed Android ID. Adjust documents lowercase MD5.
params.fix_hint: Send a 32-character lowercase MD5 hex digest.

params.name: android_id_lower_sha1
params.description: Hashed Android ID. Adjust documents lowercase SHA1.
params.fix_hint: Send a 40-character lowercase SHA1 hex digest.

params.name: android_id_upper_md5
params.description: Hashed Android ID. Adjust documents uppercase MD5.
params.fix_hint: Send a 32-character uppercase MD5 hex digest.

params.name: android_id_upper_sha1
params.description: Hashed Android ID. Adjust documents uppercase SHA1.
params.fix_hint: Send a 40-character uppercase SHA1 hex digest.

params.name: imei
params.description: Raw IMEI, without hyphens.

params.name: imei_lower_md5
params.description: Hashed IMEI. Adjust documents lowercase MD5, without hyphens.
params.fix_hint: Send a 32-character lowercase MD5 hex digest.

params.name: meid
params.description: Raw MEID. Adjust documents uppercase, without hyphens.
params.fix_hint: Send the MEID in uppercase with no hyphens.

params.name: win_naid
params.description: Windows network adapter ID.

params.name: win_hwid
params.description: Windows Store hardware ID.

params.name: adid
params.description: The Adjust identifier associated with the device. Useful for identifying LAT users on iOS without IDFA.

params.name: callback_params
params.description: It is a JSON object of string callback key-value pairs. Adjust documents it URL-encoded, with no nested objects.
params.fix_hint: Send a JSON object such as `{"f0o":"bar"}`, URL-encoded. Do not nest objects.

params.name: partner_params
params.description: It is a JSON object of string partner key-value pairs. Adjust documents it URL-encoded, with no nested objects.
params.fix_hint: Send a JSON object such as `{"f0o":"bar"}`, URL-encoded. Do not nest objects.

rules.message: The request carries no device identifier. Adjust requires an advertising ID such as `idfa` or `gps_adid`, or one of the other documented device IDs.
rules.fix_hint: Send `idfa` for iOS or `gps_adid` for Android, or another documented device ID.

rules.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Adjust documents the device IP, user agent, and advertising IDs as unhashed.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IPv4 address, user agent, or advertising ID.

rules.message: The event sends `revenue` without `currency`. Adjust documents both on revenue events.
rules.fix_hint: Add `currency` as a three-letter ISO 4217 code.

rules.message: The event sends `currency` without `revenue`. Adjust documents both on revenue events.
rules.fix_hint: Add `revenue` as a number in full currency units, such as `123.4`.

rules.message: The timestamp is outside the documented processing window.
The timestamp is outside the documented processing window.

params.name: method
params.description: Adjust supports GET or POST for this endpoint.

params.name: path
params.description: Use the /event endpoint.

params.name: body_encoding
params.description: Event parameters are in the query or a URL-encoded form body.

params.name: content_type
params.description: A submitted form body requires application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

params.name: url
params.description: The published request endpoint uses HTTPS.
